title: Introduce Runtime Control Client Seam
observed_behavior: Docker and Podman desired-state apply paths previously executed Engine API helper calls directly from the adapter apply method.
Compose desired-state apply previously executed docker compose up through the applier's CommandRunner without an explicit execution-mode result field.
Runtime configuration did not expose execution_mode for runtime targets.
intended_behavior: Runtime mutation ownership is represented by narrow runtime control clients that report execution mode.
Docker and Podman desired-state apply use direct Docker-compatible Engine API control clients and report execution_mode=engine_api.
Compose desired-state apply uses an explicit CLI-backed executor and reports execution_mode=cli.
Compose CLI compatibility mode is explicit in configuration; factory construction rejects Compose targets without execution_mode=cli.
Deployment documentation defines execution mode semantics.
scope: internal/adapters/runtime control seam and desired-state apply metadata
runtime target configuration plumbing for execution_mode
